topics.name: Optional Capability Negotiation
topics.purpose: Define deterministic negotiation of optional protocol/module/tool features using exact common capability intersection without changing required baseline semantics.

semantics.consumer_rule: Supported/requested optional capability set is exact.
semantics.intersection_rule: Negotiated set is deterministic exact intersection subject to policy.
semantics.required_rule: Required baseline capability failure cannot be masked by optional negotiation.
semantics.session_rule: Negotiated capability set binds exact session/connection/runtime context.
semantics.authority_rule: Negotiated capability never grants additional resource permissions.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.
